scientific_integrity: Analytic direct-arrival identifiability theorem, supported by a deterministic numerical checker; no empirical measurement or external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Known planar station coordinates, homogeneous isotropic speed, positive depth, direct arrivals without noise, station clock offsets or anisotropy; seven stations sufficient only, globally minimal arbitrary-array count not determined. Historical priority remains provisional where earlier full texts were inaccessible.
title: A sharp three-radius design for joint seismic depth, wave-speed and origin-time recovery
